newsitem.title: USA: Genelabs investor raises stake to 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Genelabs investor raises stake to 14 pct.

text.p: Genelabs Technologies Inc on Tuesday said it will sell 2.6 million shares of its common stock for $10.4 million to Nina Kung Wang, through her private investment firm Veron International.
With this purchase, Veron International will increase its stake in Genelabs, a biopharmaceutical firm, from about 8 percent to 14 percent of the outstanding shares.

The shares were priced at $4 per share, which is the average actual market price over a 10-day trading period. Net proceeds to the company will be about $9.5 million, after deducting estimated offering expenses and commissions.

Irene Chow, Genelabs president and chief executive, said in a statement, "This significant cash infusion strengthens the resources available for our (research and development) programs...for discovery of gene-regulating drugs, and the late stage development of our lead pharmaceutical product, GL701, for lupus," Chow continued.
